title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior spreads and persists within a population under varying policies, information environments, social influences, and supply constraints. Optional coupling to disease transmission to assess health impact.

interactions.name: social_influence
interactions.description: Individuals influence each other's beliefs and adoption via their social network ties and co-location contacts.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement
interactions.description: Government and locations enforce mask mandates; individuals comply or face penalties based on enforcement probability and compliance propensity.

interactions.name: information_diffusion
interactions.description: Media and government broadcast messages that shape risk perception, trust, and mask attitudes; misinformation may counteract official guidance.

interactions.name: purchase_masks
interactions.description: Individuals purchase masks subject to availability and price; retailers adjust stock and pricing.

interactions.name: mobility_and_context
interactions.description: Individuals move among households, workplaces/schools, and public spaces, triggering context-specific mask decisions and potential enforcement.

interactions.name: optional_disease_transmission
interactions.description: If enabled, disease spreads through contacts; mask-wearing reduces transmission probability for source and receiver.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Fraction of the population wearing masks by day and by context.

metrics.name: time_to_70_percent_adoption
metrics.description: Number of days to reach 70% mask usage in the population.

metrics.name: peak_adoption
metrics.description: Maximum observed adoption rate during the simulation.

metrics.name: sustained_adoption_after_policy
metrics.description: Average adoption rate in a post-policy window to assess persistence.

metrics.name: policy_effect_size
metrics.description: Difference in adoption with vs. without policy or before vs. after mandate.

metrics.name: adherence_by_context
metrics.description: Average mask usage in workplaces, schools, and public spaces.

metrics.name: disparity_index_by_demographic
metrics.description: Difference in adoption rates across demographic or socioeconomic groups.

metrics.name: infections_averted
metrics.description: Estimated cases prevented relative to a no-mask counterfactual (if disease module enabled).

metrics.name: R_effective
metrics.description: Effective reproduction number over time (if disease module enabled).

metrics.name: cost_per_percentage_point_adoption
metrics.description: Economic cost (e.g., spending and penalties) per 1% increase in adoption.
